title: Family Retreat: 5BR, Heated Pool, Games & Hot Tub
description:
Stay at our resort-style retreat, perfect for golf holidays and family escapes. Our tri-level home offers plenty of space with 5 bedrooms and a lively game room, accommodating up to 14 guests comfortably. Weekly discount automatically applied when staying 7 or more nights. Relax outdoors in a sprawling backyard, with a complimentary heated pool and hot tub! Located just 5 minutes from the heart of Chandler, offering many top restaurant, bar and entertainment options. One of our favorite homes

 The space 
Complimentary Heated Pool and Hot Tub 
BBQ Grill, and Putting Green
A 5 bedroom, tri-level, resort style home, designed for family travelers and groups of friends
Sleeps up to 14 guests
Ping Pong Table, shuffle board, foosball, corn hole, bocce ball, provide endless entertainment

 Other things to note 
Large backyard with heated pool and hot tub. Rare find!
Fire pit, cornhole, ping pong and more! See pics.

Weekly discount automatically applied when staying 7 or more nights.
Monthly Discount automatically applied when staying 29 nights or more.

Quiet neighborhood with strictly enforced quiet hours.
Good Neighbor Policy and City Law: Any activity or gathering that disturbs the peace or quiet of a residence or neighborhood is prohibited any time of day, particularly between the hours of 10 p.m. to 9 a.m. If a neighbor calls or comes over and asks you to quiet down, be friendly and quiet down. Rental properties cannot be used for non-residential activities such as corporate events, parties or weddings.(Noise is monitored by NoiseAware devices) The city has laws about noise disturbances. If police are called, they may impose fines that guests will be responsible for.
The property shall not be used by more than the number of adults and children listed in your reservation.
Tri-level home with 3 bedrooms upstairs and 2 downstairs. Main living room and kitchen are on the first floor
